settings.subtitle: Radar is the most-stocked budget brand in our shop with 574 active SKUs — Singapore-based engineering at a fraction of premium prices. We stock the Dimax 4SEASON (all-weather 3PMSF), Dimax Classic (all-season), Rivera PRO 2 (touring), and RPX-800 (entry-level) at 111 42 Ave SW.
settings.intro_heading: Why we recommend Radar in Calgary
settings.intro_richtext:
Radar is engineered in Singapore by Omni United and represents the best value-to-quality ratio in our budget lineup. We carry 574 active Radar SKUs — second only to Michelin in pure inventory depth — and install them at the same balance, calibrated torque, and TPMS-reset standards as a $500 Michelin job.

The Dimax 4SEASON is Radar's 3PMSF-rated all-weather option — meets Alberta's winter-tire law year-round at a price most premium brands can't touch. It's the entry-level no-swap option for Calgary commuters who want compliance without spending Michelin money.

For straight-up all-season touring, the Dimax Classic, Rivera PRO 2, and RPX-800 all run well under $200 per tire in common sedan sizes. We recommend them for older vehicles, third cars, and high-mileage drivers where premium tread life isn't worth the markup.

Every Radar we install gets the same warranty, balance, and install care as a Michelin job. Book installation or call (403) 452-4283.
settings.cta_description: Most Radar sizes in stock. Same-day install on confirmed bookings — same balance and warranty as our premium installs.
settings.faq_1_q: Is Radar a good tire brand?
settings.faq_1_a: For its price tier, yes. Radar is engineered in Singapore by Omni United and built to international DOT and ECE safety standards. We've installed thousands at Prince Tires and stand behind every set — same balance, calibrated torque, and warranty service as our premium installs.
settings.faq_2_q: How much do Radar tires cost in Calgary?
settings.faq_2_a: Radar tires at Prince Tires range from $85 to $200 per tire — typically 40-60% less than Michelin, Bridgestone, or Continental equivalents. Dimax 4SEASON starts around $144 in 16" sizes; RPX-800 starts around $100; Rivera PRO 2 around $115.
settings.faq_3_a: Yes. The Dimax 4SEASON carries the 3PMSF (three-peak mountain snowflake) symbol — it meets Alberta's winter-tire law and the BC Highway 93 / Trans-Canada Banff mandate from October through April. The cheapest 3PMSF tire we install.
settings.faq_4_q: When should I buy Radar vs a premium brand?
settings.faq_4_a: Radar makes sense for: high-mileage drivers (Uber, food delivery), third cars or older vehicles, drivers who already have winter tires and just need basic all-season summer rubber, and anyone shopping a strict budget. For new daily drivers and luxury vehicles, we recommend premium-adjacent (Cooper, Yokohama) or premium (Michelin, Bridgestone) instead.
settings.faq_5_q: Can I get same-day Radar install in Calgary?
settings.faq_5_a: Yes for most stocked sizes — Radar has the deepest budget-tier inventory in our shop. Most common sedan and crossover sizes are reliably in stock. Call (403) 452-4283 to confirm before booking.
settings.faq_6_a: Radar tires carry a standard manufacturer treadwear and defect warranty (varies by model — Dimax 4SEASON carries a 70,000 km warranty). Prince Tires processes warranty claims directly on behalf of customers. Same warranty handling as Michelin or Bridgestone.
settings.calgary_richtext: Radar is engineered in Singapore and built in Indonesia/Thailand — same balance, torque, warranty work as any premium tire. Dimax R8+ is a sleeper summer-performance pick. Renegade A/T-5 covers light trucks. Their winter Dimax Alpine is one of the cheapest 3PMSF tires we stock that we'd actually run on our own daily driver.
settings.awards_text: Singapore-engineered, ISO-9001/14001 manufacturing. 60-day satisfaction guarantee on passenger lines.
settings.testimonial_quote: Dimax Alpine on my Civic — 3PMSF for less than $130/tire. Calgary winter handled, no upselling on the install.
